description: The proof ledger of Proof-of-Done (plan task pod-16, docs/PROOF-LEDGER.md): the chain and verifyChain, the torn-tail repair, appends in turn, masking, the check receipt and its schema, the toolchain probe and recordCheck (lib/proof/ledger.mjs), and the command and output hashes of ShellRunner, run_command, tasks_run/tasks_status, test_run and build_run, and the closed schemas of the tree and call records of pod-17 and their tree ids kept whole, judged by tests/verify-proof-ledger.mjs.

mutations.name: PL-no-hash-check
mutations.what: a line whose bytes are not what its hash was made of is accepted

patches.old: if (hash !== suffix[1]) return bad('hash_mismatch', 'the line is not the text its hash was made of');

mutations.name: PL-no-prev-check
mutations.what: prev is not compared with the hash of the line before

patches.old: if (entry.prev !== prev) return bad('prev_mismatch', 'prev is not the hash of the line before');

mutations.name: PL-no-seq-check
mutations.what: seq is not compared with the line number

patches.old: if (entry.seq !== expectedSeq) return bad('seq_mismatch', `seq ${JSON.stringify(entry.seq)} where ${expectedSeq} was expected`);

mutations.name: PL-no-version-check
mutations.what: a line of another version is read as this one

mutations.name: PL-loose-time
mutations.what: ts may be any text

mutations.name: PL-unknown-type-as-bad-record
mutations.what: an unknown record type is not reported as such

mutations.name: PL-no-record-check
mutations.what: verifyChain does not validate the record of a line

mutations.name: PL-envelope-any-fields
mutations.what: a line with other or more fields than the envelope is accepted

mutations.name: PL-lossy-utf8
mutations.what: a line that is not UTF-8 is decoded with replacement characters

patches.old: const UTF8 = new TextDecoder('utf-8', { fatal: true, ignoreBOM: true });
patches.new: const UTF8 = new TextDecoder('utf-8', { fatal: false, ignoreBOM: true });

mutations.name: PL-no-line-limit-on-read
mutations.what: an over-long line is read like any other

mutations.name: PL-torn-tail-is-a-line
mutations.what: bytes without a line end are read as a committed line

patches.new: const end = bytes.indexOf(0x0a, offset) === -1 ? bytes.length : bytes.indexOf(0x0a, offset);

mutations.name: PL-broken-at-last-good
mutations.what: brokenAt names the last good line instead of the first bad one

mutations.name: PL-torn-is-broken
mutations.what: a torn tail makes the ledger refuse appends instead of being repaired

mutations.name: PL-torn-not-recorded
mutations.what: the dropped torn bytes leave no uncertain record

patches.old: await this.#appendLine(state, 'uncertain', { reason: 'torn_tail', bytes: report.torn.bytes, sha256: report.torn.sha256 });

mutations.name: PL-torn-not-dropped
mutations.what: the next line is written after the torn bytes

mutations.name: PL-no-queue
mutations.what: appends to one file do not wait for each other

mutations.name: PL-never-reload
mutations.what: a file changed by someone else is never read again

patches.old: if (state.loaded && size === state.size && mtimeMs === state.mtimeMs) return;

mutations.name: PL-size-only-reload
mutations.what: an edit that keeps the size goes unnoticed

patches.old: if (state.loaded && size === state.size && mtimeMs === state.mtimeMs) return;

mutations.name: PL-no-mask
mutations.what: records are written without masking

patches.old: const masked = maskDeep(copy, this.secrets() ?? [], KEPT_WHOLE[type] ?? null);

mutations.name: PL-mask-without-registered

patches.old: const masked = maskDeep(copy, this.secrets() ?? [], KEPT_WHOLE[type] ?? null);

patches.old: const masked = maskDeep(copy, this.secrets() ?? [], KEPT_WHOLE[type] ?? null);
